about.title: About Freight World
about.metaDescription: What Freight World is, where its data comes from and under which licences.
about.lead: Freight World generates truck jobs that could leave today from cities that exist in American Truck Simulator, and later Euro Truck Simulator 2. It is not a game and not a real freight exchange: nobody drives anything here.

rules.real: Cities, companies, depots, cargo and trailers come only from the game, as documented on Truck Simulator Wiki. Nothing is invented.
rules.unknown: What is not known for certain is stored as empty or marked as an estimate, never guessed.
rules.ids: Internal game IDs are kept where the wiki gives them, so live game data can be linked later.
rules.images: No logos, screenshots or other images from the games. City photos come from Wikimedia Commons with author and licence.

about.sourcesIntro: The sources Freight World uses or will use. Game data for California and Nevada is collected since stage 1 and shown on the city pages since stage 2.
about.sourcesCaption: Data sources, their use and their licences.
about.attributionIntro: This text appears in the footer of every page:
about.datasetTitle: Licence of the Freight World dataset
about.datasetText: The game data files Freight World publishes are derived from Truck Simulator Wiki and are shared under the same licence, CC BY-SA 4.0.
about.gamesText: American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 are games by SCS Software. Freight World is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with SCS Software.
